in_marathi.name: Prithviraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prithviraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Prithviraj means 'Ruler of the Universe'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Prithvi' which means 'earth' and 'Raj' which means 'king' or 'ruler'. This name is often given to boys born into royal families or those who are destined to become leaders and rulers in their own right.
